messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: inference-runtime /api/v1/generate error rate spike >6% (5m) in us-east-1. page: @maria (on-call). links: https://metrics.internal/redwood/inference-runtime #alert-1778004321

maria: on it. seeing 502s and 5xx spikes across the frontend -> routing layer. digging into logs, will post a quick triage.

jake: i can join in 2 mins, ping me if you need immediate failover.

maria: thanks. initial quick checks: 1) control-plane health ok, 2) worker pods showing increased OOMs and repeated restarts on some nodes, 3) redis cache connections spiking. suspect a garbage-collection/regression in the latest model-variant rollout.

incidents-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0421-42, linked to service: inference-runtime, priority: P1. Incident commander assigned: maria.

maria: assigning roles: IC = maria, comms = tara, scribe = jake. ops-lead please standby for escalation if we hit customer-impact.

tara: coms ack. i'll prepare a short customer-facing blurb if needed. can you confirm which customers are affected?

maria: currently looks like a subset of hosted API traffic hitting the new quantized variant. filtering by model-id shows higher error rates for model: redwood-v2-q4_0. cc @samir for model rollout context.

samir: yep we pushed a config tweak for q4 quantization last night. rolling back that feature flag should be straightforward. i can do it if we want immediate mitigation. downside: slight cost/regression vs latency.

maria: propose immediate mitigation: 1) rollback q4 flag for production routing, 2) drain and restart the affected worker pool, 3) scale up dedicated GPU pool by +2 for burst. jake can coordinate drain command. agree?

jake: agree. issuing drain to node-group inference-workers-eu-3? wait, it's us-east-1 -> inference-workers-us-east-2. running commands now:

```bash
# cordon + drain pods on affected nodes
kubectl cordon node/ip-10-0-34-21
kubectl drain node/ip-10-0-34-21 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
# restart runtime service on node
ssh ubuntu@ip-10-0-34-21 'sudo systemctl restart inference-runtime'
```

jake: drain started. moving traffic off those nodes. logs show many OOM kill events with process `runner`.

maria: samir, can you flip the rollout flag? provide command or UI link.

samir: flipping now. will send the rollback command to the router service.

```json
POST /admin/feature-flags/rollback
{ "flag": "quant-q4-prod", "target": "routing", "reason": "prod-error-spike-1778004321" }
```

samir: done. routing change propagated in ~18s. monitoring.

maria: error rate dropping to ~1.2% over last 2 mins. 502s falling. good sign. continuing to watch.

incidents-bot: Update: Incident INC-2026-0421-42 status -> Mitigated.

tara: customer-impact check: telemetry shows elevated latencies for customers: AcmeCorp (10% of requests), BetaApps (3%). i've drafted a holding message if execs want to send: "We've observed transient errors for a small subset of inference requests between 14:22-14:35 UTC. Root cause under investigation; mitigation applied; no persisted data loss."

ops-lead: thanks team. good containment work. let's schedule a post-incident review. propose 60m postmortem tomorrow 15:00 UTC. owner: maria + samir. action items to capture during the review: 1) root-cause analysis of q4 quantization flag interaction with runtime, 2) adjust paging thresholds to catch error-rate rise earlier, 3) add explicit handoff checklist for multi-shift oncall, 4) update runbook steps for rollback + verification, 5) add play to automate drain + fallback to warm pool.

maria: sounds good. i've created a placeholder in calendar and added the invite to #eng-postmortems. link: https://calendar.internal/event/pm-1778. attendees: maria,jake,samir,tara,ops-lead,infra-sre.

jake: capturing immediate action items now: ACTION-1 assign to samir: add a safety-check in rollout service to reject quantized variants if memory footprint > threshold. due: 2026-04-28. ACTION-2 assign to maria: update on-call runbook to include "if model rollout correlates with errors, flip routing flag and scale burst pool" + add `/runbook/incident/rollouts` section. due: 2026-04-26. ACTION-3 assign to jake: add automated alert that correlates 5xx rate with pod OOM events (pager to eng-oncall at 3x baseline). due: 2026-04-25.

ops-lead: pls ensure tasks have owners in our tracker and link PRs back to the postmortem. also let's tighten escalation: current policy waits 15m at P1 before escalating to ops-lead; propose reduce to 8m when customer impact >5% requests failing.

maria: agreed. proposal: change policy snippet in runbook:

```yaml
pagerduty:
  escalation:
    - wait: 00:05:00
      notify: on-call
    - wait: 00:03:00
      notify: ops-lead
    - condition: customer-impact > 5%
      immediate_notify: exec-incident-comm
```

maria: i'll open a PR against runbooks repo with the new thresholds + explicit handoff checklist. tagging jake for review.

samir: also recommend adding a short smoke test that runs on rollout that mimics 1k short-sample requests to validate mem usage for quantized variants. i can draft that.

tara: postmortem note for comms: include timeline, customer list, mitigation steps, and the public-safe blurb. i'll prepare first draft after the RCA.

jake: quick follow-up: please capture which nodes had OOMs and paste logs to the incident doc. sample log snippet:

```
Apr 21 14:23:09 runner[pid=2241]: OOM killer invoked: process runner exceeded 1.8GB
Apr 21 14:23:10 kernel: Out of memory: kill process 2241 (runner) score 1000
```

maria: adding final notes: incident resolved -> status: resolved, mitigation: rollback quant-q4-prod + node restarts + scale burst + alert rule changes queued. postmortem scheduled. thanks all for quick response. :white_check_mark:

ops-lead: one last admin: please ensure the runbook section "incident handoff checklist" includes explicit timestamp fields and a single place to log the next oncall person. frequently missed during late-night shifts. i'll follow up with a template PR.

maria: will do. closing thread and moving detailed logs & actions to the postmortem doc: https://docs.internal/postmortems/INC-2026-0421-42.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-0421-42 closed by maria at 14:41 UTC. Postmortem scheduled: 2026-04-22 15:00 UTC.

ops-lead: thanks team, appreciate the quick mitigation. please update your assigned ACTIONs in the tracker by EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:
